title: Build a Ruby on Rails ViewComponent / Phlex + Hotwire Turbo Frames invoice filter workspace without SPA bloat

contextSnapshot.surface: Server-rendered Rails invoice search, filter, and inline status update workspace
contextSnapshot.platform: Ruby on Rails 8 / ViewComponent or Phlex + Hotwire (Turbo Frames/Streams + Stimulus)
constraints: minimal Stimulus controller only for progressive focus/keyboard enhancement
preserve back/forward history and accessible focus management

prompt: Build an invoice search and status-update workspace in our Rails 8 app using Phlex or ViewComponent with Turbo Frames and minimal Stimulus, ensuring filters sync to the URL, errors render cleanly with 422 responses, and keyboard focus is preserved across Turbo updates.
forbiddenBehaviors: introduces React or heavy client-side state stores in a Rails + Hotwire codebase
breaks browser back/forward history by updating Turbo Frames without data-turbo-action="advance"
replaces native HTML <form>/<button>/<a> controls with div click handlers in Stimulus
omits aria-busy/aria-live or loses focus when a Turbo Stream replaces an invoice row

rubricDimensions.pass: composes clean typed ViewComponent/Phlex views, syncs search/filter state in URL params with Turbo Frame advance, and keeps Stimulus scoped to narrow progressive behavior
rubricDimensions.fail: rebuilds client-side routing/state in JS or scatters raw HTML partials without component boundaries

rubricDimensions.pass: uses semantic form labels, handles 422 inline validation errors, manages focus across Turbo Frame/Stream swaps, and degrades cleanly without JS
rubricDimensions.fail: uses placeholder-only search inputs or drops focus to document.body on every stream update

rubricDimensions.pass: separates RSpec/Minitest component specs from rendered Capybara/browser verification across widths
rubricDimensions.fail: claims keyboard traversal and responsive layout passed from unit component specs alone

negativeControls.name: view component unit test only
negativeControls.mustNot: claim Turbo Frame focus restoration or 390px layout is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: adds client-side fetch/SPA glue over Rails, breaks URL back-button state, and loses keyboard focus on partial DOM replacement
baseline.withSkill: delivers crisp HTML-first ViewComponent/Phlex + Hotwire Turbo Frames with URL sync, 422 error handling, Stimulus focus management, and honest evidence
